# Load packages
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ARTool)
library(rcompanion)
```

# Define Functions
```{r}
se <- function (x) {sd (x,na.rm =TRUE) / sqrt (length(na.exclude (x)))}

fun_hal <- function (x) {(x - (-286.8851)) / 65.1187}
fun_hol <- function (x) {(x - 284.2803) / 422.3727}
fun_hac <- function (x) {(x - 249.5578) / 839.3971}
```

```{r}
fun_process_data <- function(dat) {  # this function wrangles data coming from the online software
  
  dat |>
    filter(!grepl("(B1|B2|B3)$", Sample)) |>  # remove blanks
    mutate(
      area = ifelse(is.na(Area), 0, Area)  # set NA (=not detected) as 0
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(  # exclude two unnecessary columns
      -Qualifier_Status,
      -Qualifier_Message
    ) |>
    separate(  # separate the column Sample into columns date, segment, iteration
      col = Sample,
      into = c("date","iteration"),
      sep = "_"
    ) |>
    mutate(  # convert iteration to minutes -> one takes 15 mins to measure, so we average the time
      iteration = as.numeric(iteration),
      time_min = iteration * 15 + 90,  # add 90, cuz incubation for 90 mins after wounding, before cut and put in vials
      quant = ifelse(
        Compound == "HAL", fun_hal(area),
        ifelse(
          Compound == "HOL", fun_hol(area),
          ifelse(Compound == "HAC", fun_hac(area), area)
        )
      ),
      quant = ifelse(area == 0, 0, quant)
    )
}
```

# Load data

```{r}
getwd()
dat_mr1 <- read.csv("01_SPME_GC_MS/01_data/01_data_onlinesoftware/20261125_results.csv",
                    header = T, sep = ","
                    )
```

```{r}
dat_mr1_1 <- fun_process_data(dat_mr1)

# add col "segment", odd iterations are S1 (wounded), even iterations are S2 (unwounded)

dat_mr1_2 <- dat_mr1_1 |>
  mutate(segment = ifelse(
    iteration %% 2 == 0, "S2", "S1"  # the %% operator divides by 2, if it's == 0 it's even (3/2 = 1 and 1 left over kind of)
  ))
```

plot:

```{r}
# plot combined dat:

pal1 <- c("#ffb703","#8ecae6", "#fd9e02","#219ebc",
          "#fb8500", "#126782")

dat_mr1_2$segment <- as.factor(dat_mr1_2$segment)
dat_mr1_2$Compound <- as.factor(dat_mr1_2$Compound)


dat_plot <- dat_mr1_2 |>
  group_by(segment, time_min, Compound) |>
  mutate(mean_a = mean(quant),
         se_a = se(quant)) |>
  ungroup()

dat_plot <- subset(dat_plot, Compound != "D-Limonene")

max(dat_plot$time_min)

plot1 <- ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = time_min, y = mean_a, fill = segment, color = segment)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Compound, scales = "free_y") +
  # geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_a-se_a, ymax= mean_a + se_a), width=0) +
#   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_a - se_a, 
# 		    ymax = mean_a + se_a),
# 		    alpha = 0.3,
# 		    colour = NA) +
  geom_point() + geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = pal1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,600), expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks=seq(0,600,60)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal1) +
   theme(text = element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                        color = "white"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x=element_text(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color='black'),
        title = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(x = "time (min)", y = "area")

plot1
```
